messages.text: BL-1677 🎵 in progress — Three property files (bl1354, bl1389, bl1380) still sweep every os.tmpdir() entry sharing their prefix before each invariant - a concurrent run of the same file (QA's lane beside coder2's, 2026-09-21) rm -rf's a live peer's fixture mid-classify, and BL-1623's blind-sweep finder misses them because they alias os.tmpdir() into a variable (the guard reports [] on the live tree); bl1354SharedPathLandedSiblingInvariants read every landed sibling as unlanded with no warning, the exact report a partial object loss produces (emulated) - the three sweeps go through sweepStaleTmpDirs over pid-named roots and the finder matches the aliased form
